headline: Council approves Kula well site purchase 9–0, hears testimony on Bill 88

meeting.summary: The purchase covers 1.714 acres in Kula from Haleakalā Ranch Company. The council also passed Bills 69, 83, 92 and 93 on final reading, 9–0, and heard Office of Hawaiian Affairs and condo owner testimony on Bill 88.
meeting.recap: A department official said the well was drilled on Haleakalā Ranch land instead of the planned spot.[[0:21:06]] The council approved the well site purchase 9–0.[[0:34:55]] Resolution 26-108 gives the Maui Planning Commission more time on the South Maui Community Plan update.[[0:50:32]] Resolution 26-109 urges the Mayor to support a long-term lease to protect a cultural reserve.[[0:52:48]] The Office of Hawaiian Affairs testified against Bill 88 and asked the council to defer it.[[0:54:39]] A condo board president testified that all 26 owners at his complex support Bill 88.[[0:59:09]] The council passed Bills 69, 83, 92 and 93 on final reading, 9–0.[[1:07:07]] Bill 88 creates new H3 and H4 hotel zoning districts.[[1:11:51]]
meeting.next: The department said completing the purchase lets it do geo work on the property and start the design process.

Land purchase for new Upcountry well at Haleakalā Ranch

issues.oneLine: The county is buying 1.714 acres in Kula from Haleakalā Ranch Company for a well site.
issues.why: A council member said the well will increase upcountry water and help the Department of Water Supply work through the upcountry wait list.
issues.next: The department plans geo work on the property so it can start designing the well.
issues.brief: The well was drilled on Haleakalā Ranch land instead of next to the county's tank.[[#1]] The well is expected to produce about a million gallons per day.[[#2]] The council voted 9–0 to approve the purchase.[[#3]]
